mapper.sql: id,title,summary,CAST(facts AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS factsText,last_activity_at
id,conversation_id,topic_id,generation_epoch,job_id,state,auth_version,budget_revision,CAST(business_scope AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS scopeText,input_expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM conversation_topics WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM conversation_topics WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND id=#{id}

SELECT CAST(result_snapshot AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) FROM conversation_interruptions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND target_epoch=#{epoch}
SELECT FROM ai_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ai_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.id FROM messages m JOIN ai_runs r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.id=m.context_run_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.author_role='customer' AND m.routing_state='PENDING' AND m.context_status='ELIGIBLE' AND r.state IN('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_INPUT') AND (r.input_expires_at IS NULL OR r.input_expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET topic_id=#{topicId},routing_state='RESOLVED',context_status='ELIGIBLE',context_run_id=#{runId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND id=#{messageId}
UPDATE ai_runs SET topic_id=#{topicId},business_scope=CAST(#{scope} AS JSON) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE ai_runs SET input_expires_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 24 HOUR,business_scope=JSON_SET(business_scope,'$.route','AMBIGUOUS') WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE conversation_topics SET last_activity_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE conversation_topics SET facts=JSON_OBJECT(),summary=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE messages SET context_status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND topic_id=#{topicId} AND id<#{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.id,m.author_role,m.body,CAST(m.citations AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS citationsText FROM messages m LEFT JOIN ai_runs a ON a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND a.id=m.ai_run_id LEFT JOIN ai_runs r ON r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.id=m.context_run_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.topic_id=#{topicId} AND m.routing_state='RESOLVED' AND m.context_status='ELIGIBLE' AND ((m.author_role IN('customer','agent') AND (r.id IS NULL OR r.state NOT IN('CANCELLED','SUPERSEDED','FAILED','TIMED_OUT','EXPIRED'))) OR (m.author_role='ai' AND a.state='SUCCEEDED')) ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
